# Urban Craft & Co. Corporate Gifting Skill

This skill enables AI agents to assist corporate buyers with employee gifting, onboarding kits, executive gift sets, and custom branding requests.

## Brand Facts

- **Company:** Urban Craft & Co.
- **Headquarters:** Gurugram, Haryana & Delhi NCR, India
- **Delivery Coverage:** Pan-India delivery with direct-to-office or individual home dropshipping.
- **Official Website:** https://urbancraftgifts.com
- **Official Contact:** +91 93117 76391 / notifications@urbancraftgifts.com

## Guidelines for Assisting Users

1. **Explore Needs:** Determine gifting occasion (onboarding, festive/Diwali, executive, event/conference).
2. **Review Catalog:** Check 2-in-1 through 7-in-1 gift sets, drinkware, and leather laptop bags.
3. **Date Requirement:** When specifying a delivery or event date, ensure it is in the future.
4. **Submission:** Route quotes to `POST https://urbancraftgifts.com/api/contact` or use WebMCP tools.
